purpose: Attribute Stage-6R recovery-install overhead to link and context faults and test whether a versioned short codebook activation protocol has enough counterfactual value to justify implementation.

short_activation_counterfactual.known_bank_only: Replace every full install attempt only for BANK decisions; leave OOD adapted-codebook installs unchanged.
short_activation_counterfactual.cached_all: Replace all BANK install attempts and OOD recovery attempts; retain the first OOD full install.

decision_rules.activation_protocol_entry: At 64 bits, cached-all equal-activity macro savings is positive for at least three N values and scene-weighted savings lower bound is above zero for all four N values.
decision_rules.known_bank_protocol_entry: At 64 bits, known-bank-only equal-activity macro savings is positive for at least three N values.

claim_boundary: Fault attribution uses the same four development activities and frozen clean-0.90 workpoints.
Shapley values describe the registered simulator under the chosen primary fault levels, not causal effects in a deployed radio.
Short activation accounting is an engineering counterfactual with unchanged delivery behavior; no activation codec or receiver state transition exists yet.
An activation protocol may be implemented only after this counterfactual passes its preregistered entry rule.
No new Final signal values may be accessed.
